title: ci: publish charts with app RC version on main push
body: ## Summary Aligns chart and app versioning so both artifacts receive the same tags on every event: 1. **New `helm-publish` job in `ci.yaml`** — runs on every main push and publishes each component's Helm chart with `--version` and `--app-version` set to the same RC version tag the corresponding image receives from the `oci-build` reusable workflow. This ensures chart and app tags stay in lockstep for RC builds. 2. **Added Cosign signing to `helm-publish.yaml`** — the release-time chart publishing workflow now also signs charts with keyless Cosign (Sigstore OIDC), consistent with the new CI helm-publish job and the image signing already in place. 3. **Added `cosign login`** — fixes `UNAUTHORIZED` error when pushing chart signatures to GHCR (Cosign needs its own registry auth, separate from Helm's). **Before:** On main pushes, app images were published with RC tags (e.g. `1.1.18-rc.20260414194220.b286051`) but no charts were published. Charts were only published on release events, unsigned. **After:** On main pushes, both app images and Helm charts are published with the same RC version for each component (frontend, backend, backup). On releases, both are published with the release semver. All chart artifacts are now Cosign-signed. ## Review & Testing Checklist for Human - [ ] Merge the prerequisite PR in `bcit-tlu/.github` ([#5](https://github.com/bcit-tlu/.github/pull/5)) first — adds `rc_version` / `changed` outputs to `oci-build.yaml` (**already merged**) - [ ] After merging, verify a main push produces charts in GHCR with the same version tag as the app images (e.g. `ghcr.io/bcit-tlu/hriv/charts/hriv-frontend:`) - [ ] Verify chart Cosign signatures are present (no `UNAUTHORIZED` error) ### Notes The same `cosign login` fix is applied to tech-ops-docs in [#16](https://github.com/bcit-tlu/technical-operations-documentation/pull/16). Link to Devin session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/c9c8c3ce533d4ff88d5015f0d9b32edb Requested by: @kphunter ---
